liebermann.notes: Henry of Huntingdon, early 13th century, followed at f. 79v by the Tripartita (Wl art, ECf retr) and the Genealogia Normannica with readings like Lb; then f. 86 'Hic est annus qui comprehendit' from Huntingdon VIII and f. 87 bishop lists from William of Malmesbury's Gesta Pontificum, continued to the early 13th century. Arnold calls it a 'transcript of Lb'.
